Alibaba dropped Qwen3.8-27B. 27 billion parameters, Apache 2.0, free, and people who've run it are putting it between Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 5. It runs on an RTX 4090 at 65 tokens/sec. Or a used 3090. Or anything with 17GB of RAM via Unsloth's quants. The viral take is that it beats Opus on every benchmark. It doesn't. Alibaba's own table: wins SWE-bench Pro 61.7 vs 53.4, loses Terminal-Bench, GPQA Diamond and HLE. And Opus 4.6 is last generation. Still absurd for 27B. The part nobody's covering: within a day of the weights landing, community versions with the refusals removed were on Hugging Face. 24,000 downloads on the biggest one. Once weights are local, the cloud filter stops being the moat. Same reason Hugging Face reached for an open model when the APIs refused to help investigate their breach. Better than Claude? No. Last gen's frontier, on a gaming GPU, for free. #ai #opensource #qwen #localllm #llm
